## Live replacement

**Live file swap: static only.** Build a new GDI, then session swap with keep_state (save state -> launch mod -> load state). live_inject refuses DOA2: CHR is deformed in RAM every frame (SUP/APV/ACS)

**Pick whip: partial.** pick_identify backend 'doa2': doa2_context.inspect_actor on a RAM snapshot gives actor -> CHR/model/texture tables and slot fighter:<F>:<NN>; two fighters split by screen half; replaceable.live=false, so pick_replace builds + swaps. Not run live yet (docs/live-inject.md)

**Live controls:** RAM via RetroArch network commands (READ/WRITE_CORE_MEMORY, else the RAM view READ/WRITE_CORE_RAM with read-back; 512-byte writes). doa2_bot (fightbot reflex + survival loop), cheats op=add, save/load state, session swap. No DOA2 live sliders.

## Gaps before a live swap / pick whip

- profiles/gamedata/1de2e7634f3161ff-ram.json, named in doa2_dc.py, is not in this checkout
- the mixed random build and its confirm hook were never run in an emulator
- no live costume pick: the select cursor record (base r12 + player<<7) has no fixed RAM address, so a RAM write at confirm in place of the exe hook is unmapped
- fighter world positions are unmapped, so the pick whip chooses a fighter by screen half
- only Amy->KTE01 and GEN00->LEI05 are proven in game; no live model write (per-frame SUP/APV/ACS deformation)
- pick_tool says the writer patches the exe, but the single-costume path leaves 1ST_READ.BIN unchanged (only the mixed random build patches it)
